info.name: DRS Bus API (Full)
info.description:
Full API test suite for the DRS Bus backend: every endpoint in server/src/routes, with happy paths, validation errors, role checks and business rules.

RUN IT TOP TO BOTTOM (Collection Runner or Newman). Each folder uses values saved by the folders before it.

⚠️ It creates real records (a route, buses, a driver, trips, bookings, payments). Run it against a LOCAL or TEST database, never production.
